snippet.title: Warhammer 40,000: Darktide - Hive Scum Class Reveal | Cinematic Trailer
snippet.description:
Darktide's new class Hive Scum is coming to Darktide December 2, 2025!

Wishlist now
► https://fatshark.games/qHen6G

The Hive Scum comes screaming from the depths of the hive, leaving destruction and mayhem as they decimate their enemies with dual-wielding pistols & explosives from afar. 

Up close they are equally lethal, fighting dirty and tearing through enemies with makeshift crowbars, saws and dual-wielded shivs. Their fighting prowess is further enhanced by toxins and signature customizable Stimm.

Click the link below to find out more and stay tuned for more details about the new class leading up to the release!

Learn more about Darktide's new class!
► https://fatshark.games/5yogde

Players will be able to purchase the new class on all platforms for $11.99 / €11.99 on December 2.
